cards.name: John Sheppard

text.table: Reaction: After one of your [[ship]] warps, you may send an [[away team]] to a [[location]] where you have a [[ship]].
text.goal: Endgame: Score [[1vp]] for each [[ship]] you have in play.

cards.flavor: He'll fly anything. Usually he has to.

cards.name: Atlantis

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Deploy this ship.
text.table: Activation: Discard a card to beam a card here. Activation: Promote a [[person]] from your hand to Duty Officer. Reaction: When you would be attacked, you may dismiss a ZPM to ignore the negative effect.

cards.flavor: A city built to fly, asleep under an ocean for ten thousand years.

cards.name: Elizabeth Weir

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Gain 1 [[influence]] and gain an [[ally]].
text.table: Reaction: After gaining an [[ally]], gain 1 [[influence]]. Passive: You may have an additional [[person]] on duty.

cards.flavor: She came to Pegasus to talk. Pegasus kept making that hard.

cards.name: Jennifer Keller

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Return up to 2 [[incident]] from your hand or Discard pile.

cards.flavor: She never wanted the job. She kept everyone alive anyway.

cards.name: Samantha Carter

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Gain 1 [[research]]. You may dismiss a ZPM to gain 2 [[research]] and draw 2 cards.

cards.flavor: Hand her a power source and a deadline.

cards.name: Todd

text.hand: [[action]] Attack Play: Return an [[incident]] from your hand or Discard pile. Your opponent takes an [[incident]]. Log this card.

cards.flavor: An ally, right up until he is hungry.

cards.name: Ancient Warship

text.hand: [[action]] Attack Play: Deploy this ship and warp it. If your opponent has a [[ship]] there, they discard 2 cards.
text.table: Activation: Spend 1 [[dilithium]] to warp this ship. Activation: Discard a card to beam a card here.

cards.flavor: Built for the war against the Wraith, and still built for it.

cards.name: Control Chair

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Deploy this card. Gain 1 [[military]].
text.table: Attack Activation: Discard a card to remove an opponent [[away team]] from a [[location]] where you have an [[away team]]. If you do, gain 1 [[glory]], and 1 [[military]] if you have a ZPM in play.

cards.flavor: Think about where the drones should go. Think about nothing else.

cards.name: Asuras

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Take control of this location. Control: You may take an [[incident]] to find a ZPM. You may play it for free.
text.table: Activation: If you have an [[away team]] here, draw a card. If you have 3+ total [[away team]] on 1 or more controlled [[location]], draw a card.

cards.flavor: The Ancients' weapon against the Wraith, abandoned and still resentful.

cards.name: Janus's Lab

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Take control of this location. Control: Gain 2 [[research]].
text.goal: Endgame: Score [[1vp]] for each [[scientist]] you own.

cards.flavor: Hidden rooms, unfinished experiments, and things nobody was meant to find.

cards.name: Ronon Dex

text.hand: [[action]] Attack Play: Discard a card to remove an opponent [[away team]] from a [[location]]. If you do, gain 1 [[military]] and 1 [[glory]].
text.table: Activation: Spend 1 [[dilithium]] to send an [[away team]] to a [[location]] where you have a [[ship]].

cards.flavor: Seven years as the prey. Now he does the hunting.

cards.name: Carson Beckett

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Gain 1 [[research]]. Draw a [[person]] from your Discard pile.
text.table: Activation: Spend 2 [[dilithium]] to find a [[person]] with [[augment]].

cards.flavor: A doctor with the gene, a needle, and no wish at all to fly.

cards.name: Daedalus

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Deploy this ship. You may find a ZPM.
text.table: Activation: Spend 1 [[dilithium]] to warp this ship. Activation: Discard a card to beam a card here OR recall a card beamed to a [[ship]].

cards.flavor: The long road home, one jump at a time.

cards.name: ZPM

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Deploy this card.

cards.flavor: Enough power to change everything, once.

cards.name: Hive Ship

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Dismiss a ZPM OR spend 3 [[dilithium]] to return this card.

cards.flavor: The Wraith are awake, and they are hungry.

cards.name: Naquadah Generators

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Gain 1 [[dilithium]], and 2 [[dilithium]] for each controlled [[location]] you have in play. [[action]] Play: Gain on one Specialty track ([[research]]/[[influence]]/[[military]]) for each matching Skill icon you have in play (excluding beamed cards).

cards.flavor: Not a ZPM, but enough to keep the lights on.

cards.name: New Arrivals

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Put a card on the top of your deck to gain a [[person]]. [[action]] Play: Take an [[incident]] to gain an [[ally]].

cards.flavor: Every supply run brings new faces and new problems.

cards.name: Ancient Database

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Take an [[incident]] to gain a [[ship]]. [[action]] Play: Discard 2 cards to gain a [[cargo]]. Play: Gain 2 [[dilithium]].

cards.flavor: The answer is in there. So are ten thousand others.

cards.name: Culling

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Remove one of your [[away team]] OR put a card on the top of your deck to return this card.

cards.flavor: The darts come in low, and the beam takes whoever it touches.

cards.name: The Mainland

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Take control of this location. Control: Gain 2 [[latinum]].
text.table: Activation: If you have an [[away team]] here, draw a card. If you have 3+ total [[away team]] on 1 or more controlled [[location]], draw a card.

cards.flavor: Fields to farm, partners to trade with, and a long way from the gate.

cards.name: Puddle Jumper

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Deploy this ship. You may warp it.
text.table: Activation: Warp this ship. Unless an [[augment]] is beamed here, spend 1 [[dilithium]] first. Activation: Discard a card to beam a card here.

cards.flavor: Ford wanted a grander name. He was outvoted.

cards.name: Rodney McKay

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Draw 2 cards and discard one of them. Gain 1 [[research]].
text.table: Activation: Spend 2 [[dilithium]] to gain 1 [[research]], and 1 more if you have a ZPM in play.

cards.flavor: Genius, hypochondriac, and annoyingly often right.

cards.name: Teyla Emmagan

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Gain 1 [[influence]]. You may return an [[incident]] from your hand or Discard pile.
text.table: Activation: Spend 2 [[latinum]] to scan 2 of [[ally]] and gain 1 [[glory]].

cards.flavor: She knows every trading partner in Pegasus, and she feels the Wraith coming.

cards.name: Aiden Ford

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Send an [[away team]] to a [[location]] where you have a [[ship]]. Gain 1 [[military]].

cards.flavor: Loyal, young, and changed by the enzyme.

cards.name: Radek Zelenka

text.hand: [[action]] Play: Gain 1 [[research]]. You may refresh a [[ship]].
text.table: Activation: Spend 1 [[dilithium]] to draw a ZPM from your Discard pile.

cards.flavor: Second only to McKay, and quick to deliver the bad news.

text.goal: Goal: A [[scientist]], a [[telepath]] and a [[security]] beamed to the same [[ship]], and [[res4]].
Goal: A ZPM in play, and [[res8]].

text.reward: Reward: Gain 2 [[glory]]. You may return an [[incident]] from your hand or Discard pile.
